run_gmock_doctor: pipe compiler error messages into gmock_doctor.py via stdin to diagnose Google Mock usage problems
diagnose_gmock_errors: call Diagnose() with a compiler error message string to get human-readable Google Mock diagnoses
review_generic_diagnoser: review the _GenericDiagnoser function that pattern-matches compiler errors against regex rules to yield diagnoses
review_need_to_return_reference_diagnose: review the _NeedToReturnReferenceDiagnoser function that detects when Return() should be ReturnRef()
review_need_to_return_something_diagnose: review the _NeedToReturnSomethingDiagnoser function that detects when a void action is used in a non-void context
